label: Café
note: A DRAFT written by the model from general knowledge (no web research). Every page is an idea until a person has read it.

pages.title: Home
pages.purpose: Introduces the café with its atmosphere, signature items, opening hours and a clear path to the menu and location.

pages.title: Menu
pages.purpose: Lists coffee, tea, food and pastries with descriptions and prices so visitors know what to expect.

pages.title: About Us
pages.purpose: Tells the story of the café, its values and why the owners opened it.

pages.title: Gallery
pages.purpose: Shows photos of the space, drinks, food and daily life in the café.

pages.title: Contact & Location
pages.purpose: Gives the address, map, opening hours, phone number and a contact form or email.

pages.title: Order Online
pages.purpose: Lets customers order drinks and food for pickup or delivery.

pages.title: Reserve a Table
pages.purpose: Lets visitors book a table for a chosen date, time and party size.

pages.title: Coffee & Drinks
pages.purpose: Details the coffee, tea and specialty drinks, including milk alternatives and sizes.

pages.title: Food & Pastries
pages.purpose: Showcases breakfast, lunch, sandwiches and baked goods, with dietary labels.

pages.title: Daily Specials
pages.purpose: Highlights the seasonal and daily offers that change regularly.

pages.title: Reviews
pages.purpose: Collects customer testimonials and ratings to build trust with new visitors.

pages.title: Meet the Team
pages.purpose: Introduces the baristas, bakers and owners behind the counter.

pages.title: Events
pages.purpose: Announces live music, open mic nights, book clubs and other gatherings at the café.

pages.title: Private Events & Hire
pages.purpose: Explains how to hire the café or a section of it for parties and meetings.

pages.title: Catering
pages.purpose: Offers coffee, sandwiches and pastries for offices and events, with packages and enquiry details.

pages.title: Gift Cards
pages.purpose: Sells gift cards or vouchers that people can give to friends and family.

pages.title: Shop Beans & Merchandise
pages.purpose: Sells coffee beans, tea, mugs and other merchandise.

pages.title: Loyalty Program
pages.purpose: Explains how regulars earn rewards, stamps or discounts.

pages.title: Our Coffee & Suppliers
pages.purpose: Shares where the beans, milk and ingredients come from and how they are roasted or prepared.

pages.title: Workshops & Classes
pages.purpose: Offers barista classes, latte art sessions or baking workshops that visitors can sign up for.

pages.title: Blog & News
pages.purpose: Shares news, recipes, seasonal updates and stories from the café.

pages.title: Careers
pages.purpose: Lists open positions and how to apply to join the team.

pages.title: FAQ
pages.purpose: Answers common questions about Wi-Fi, pets, accessibility, dietary options and opening times.

homeSectionIdeas: Hero with a welcoming photo, café name and a button to the menu
Signature drinks and favorite items with photos
Opening hours and address with a small map
Short story about the café and its people
Photo gallery or social feed preview
Call to action for ordering, booking or visiting
styleNotes: Warm, inviting colors such as cream, coffee brown and soft green or terracotta
Large, appetizing photography of drinks, food and the cozy interior
Friendly, readable typography, perhaps a handwritten or soft serif accent for headings
Mobile-first layout with quick access to menu, hours and directions
